updates.assessment: Parameter Add leaves the new row unselected; Edit edits the first selectedItems entry (selection insertion order) even with several selected, using the exact Enter parameter message/default/placeholder and reference first-line whitespace cleaning. Delete captures indices and asks Remove N selected?, with decline/close unchanged. Up/Down iterate original selected indices including selected neighbours at boundaries, preserving Qt current focus and Shift origin. Focused list extended selection, arrows/Home/End, Ctrl+A/C/Insert/Space and Delete (macOS Backspace too) reach the real queue. Selected-text copy preserves selectedItems insertion order; the command example uses cleaned values. Child/parent Cancel and retired callbacks discard drafts; accepted values persist/reopen and feed saved Process.command token substitution. Select-all retains the previous Shift origin; Ctrl navigation replaces that origin without changing selected rows. Captured deletion chooses the previous current neighbour and retains its range origin. Reverse-order Edit and all five origin/deletion histories match actual Qt and native real pointer/key dispatch.
limitations: Broader external-program/list/reopen and command/process parents remain Partial; executable picker/PATH/availability breadth, OS launch routing and full process output are not claimed. No new windows or parent/alias promotions.
